SELECT b.id,b.parent_id, b.`dept_name`,b.`level`,b.`remark`,b.create_time,b.update_time FROM( SELECT (SELECT @r := parent_id FROM sys_dept WHERE id = @r) AS id FROM (SELECT @r := #{deptId}) a, sys_dept WHERE @r <> 'ROOT' ) a JOIN sys_dept b ON a.id = b.id UNION ALL
SELECT id,parent_id,`dept_name`,`level`,`remark`,create_time,update_time FROM sys_dept
AND `dept_name` like concat('%', #{deptName}, '%')
ORDER BY `level`,parent_id,create_time ASC
SELECT id, parent_id, `dept_name` FROM sys_dept ORDER BY id

SELECT id,`dept_name` FROM( SELECT @ids AS _ids,(SELECT @ids := GROUP_CONCAT(id) FROM sys_dept WHERE FIND_IN_SET(parent_id, @ids)) AS cids FROM sys_dept,(SELECT @ids := #{parentId}) b WHERE @ids IS NOT NULL ) a,sys_dept b WHERE FIND_IN_SET(b.id,a._ids) ORDER BY LEVEL,id
